Package io.github.lord_of_nothing.game

Class HungerMechanic

java.lang.Object
io.github.lord_of_nothing.game.HungerMechanic
public class HungerMechanic extends Object
Manages the population hunger level that changes twice per in-game day (at 6:00 and 18:00).

At each settlement hour every citizen consumes 24 food unit(s). If the food supply is sufficient the hunger bar rises slowly; if food runs out it falls. At 0 % the game ends.
